question: Do I need a local business licence to operate, and how do I get one?

nuggets.text: Where the locality requires a licence it is unlawful to do business without first obtaining it.
nuggets.quote: Whenever a license is required by ordinance adopted pursuant to this chapter and whenever the local governing body shall impose a license fee or levy a license tax on any business, employment or profession, it shall be unlawful to engage in such business, employment or profession without first obtaining the required license.

nuggets.text: The issuance fee is capped by the locality's population ($100 / $50 / $30).
nuggets.quote: The governing body of any county, city or town may charge a fee for issuing a license in an amount not to exceed $100 for any locality with a population greater than 50,000, $50 for any locality with a population of 25,000 but no more than 50,000 and $30 for any locality with a population smaller than 25,000.

nuggets.text: Apply before beginning business, or by March 1 of the licensing year if already licensed.
nuggets.quote: Each person subject to a license tax shall apply for a license prior to beginning business if he was not subject to licensure in this jurisdiction on or before January 1 of the license year, or no later than March 1 of the license year if he had been issued a license for the preceding year.

nuggets.text: An assessment can be appealed administratively to the local assessing officer and then to the Tax Commissioner.
nuggets.quote: Administrative appeals to commissioner of the revenue or other assessing official. a.

nuggets.text: In Albemarle County the Department of Finance & Budget (Office of Revenue Administration) handles the business licence.
nuggets.quote: Department of Finance & Budget, Office of Revenue Administration (Business & Personal Tax Unit); the Director of Finance holds the commissioner of the revenue's assessing powers under the county executive form of government

nuggets.text: The county's New Business License Application is filed within 30 days of starting business.
nuggets.quote: Use the county's 2026 New Business License Application (form dated 11/2025). Enter the date the business began in the county, the type of business, the legal and trade names, and your Social Security number or federal EIN.
